notes: BLX288/SM58 is a dual-channel handheld wireless vocal system comprising two BLX2/SM58 handheld transmitters and one BLX88 dual-channel receiver. The BLX2/SM58 transmitter is battery-powered (2x AA, up to 14 hrs) and has no physical audio/data ports to model (mic capsule and battery door only) — all listed ports below belong to the BLX88 receiver, which is the only unit with physical I/O. The receiver's antennas are fixed/internal (non-detachable, no BNC antenna connector) so no antenna port is included. Power is supplied via an external PS24-type 12V DC wall/inline power supply terminating in a coaxial barrel plug (tip positive); some sources list receiver DC input tolerance as 12-15V DC @ ~320mA. No grade applies to any port (analog audio and DC power only). Frequency band variant (H9, H10, H11, J11, etc.) affects RF tuning only, not physical I/O. Desktop/tabletop unit — rack-mountable only with optional URT2 rack tray accessory, so rackUnits omitted per instructions (not inherently rack-mountable).
